answer: Policies are written in island, settled in mesa, and nebula lists every payout. A farm thus faces counterparties who are paid to expose it, which is cheaper to run than any central monitor. Peers may post insurance against an identity's behaviour and collect 18% of its slashed stake when it misbehaves, creating a market that profits from finding fraud. That bill is paid per identity, so 372 aliases cost 86 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
